subject: Quick demo for BrightPath — usage spike + tailored walkthrough
body:
From: Redwood Platform <noreply@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@brightpath.ai>
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2027 15:21:00 -0700
Subject: You just crossed a usage milestone on Redwood — want a tailored walkthrough?

Hi Alex,

Nice work — your project 'BrightPath-Search' just crossed 150k tokens in the last 7 days. Users who hit this tier often see a quick lift from a short walkthrough where we:
- Review batching and KV cache tips to cut token cost
- Suggest a model/quantization trade-off for the observed sequence lengths
- Walk through Redwood Console for tracing and cost dashboards

If you'd like, Naomi (our SDR focused on power users) can set up a 30-minute tailored walkthrough. Reply with a time or pick a slot: https://calendar.redwood.com/s/naomi/30min?token=abc123

Thanks,
Redwood Platform

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: You just crossed a usage milestone on Redwood — want a tailored walkthrough?

Alex — congrats on the uptick! I'm Naomi on the Customer Growth team. I focus on short technical walkthroughs for teams that are starting to scale usage.

Would love to run through a focused agenda:
1) Quick look at your usage report and common cost levers (10 min)
2) Live demo of two config changes we recommend (10 min)
3) Q&A + next steps (10 min)

Are any of these windows good for you this week?
- Tue Aug 10, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Aug 11, 13:00–13:30 PT
- Thu Aug 12, 16:00–16:30 PT

I attached a one-pager with common optimizations and the usage CSV export I pulled from your project (redwood-demo-one-pager.pdf; usage-report-2027-08-06.csv). If none of the times above work, reply with 2 slots that do and I will coordinate.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Growth — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

---

From: Alex Turner <alex@brightpath.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sales Ops <salesops@brightpath.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: You just crossed a usage milestone on Redwood — want a tailored walkthrough?

Hi Naomi — thanks for the note and for pulling that report. Wed 13:00 PT works in principle, but I have a recurring all-hands that sometimes runs long. Can we either do Wed 12:30–13:00 PT or Thu 16:00–16:30 PT instead? Also, quick ask: could you include a short section on tokenization differences for long prompts? That's our main cost mystery right now.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Lead ML Engineer, BrightPath AI
alex@brightpath.ai

On Tue, 10 Aug 2027 at 09:12 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — congrats on the uptick! I'm Naomi on the Customer Growth team...
> [Quoted available slots]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 07:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: You just crossed a usage milestone on Redwood — want a tailored walkthrough?

Perfect — thanks for the heads up on the all-hands. Wed 12:30–13:00 PT is fine. I'll lock that slot and send a calendar invite. We'll make sure to include a 5 min micro-section on tokenization behavior for our models and how that shows up in the Console (what to look for in the token breakdowns).

I've attached the updated one-pager and the detailed usage CSV to the invite. If you have any internal stakeholders who should be looped in (engineering lead, infra, or procurement for next steps), feel free to CC them and I'll expand the invite.

Naomi Feldman
Growth — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-demo-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf), usage-report-2027-08-06.csv (text/csv)

> On Wed, 11 Aug 2027 at 08:37 Alex Turner <alex@brightpath.ai> wrote:
> > Hi Naomi — thanks for the note and for pulling that report. Wed 13:00 PT works...

Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: You just crossed a usage milestone on Redwood — want a tailored walkthrough?

Alex — invite sent for Wed Aug 11, 12:30–13:00 PT (I scheduled in your preferred calendar via the scheduling link). Rishi will join as well for a couple minutes to cover rollout options if you want canary traffic and staged model swaps.

If anything changes, reply directly to this thread. Looking forward to it — we should have a short list of actionable items by the end of the call.

Best,
Naomi
